newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-HOUSTON'S WILLIS, SEATTLE'S KEMP FINED.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-HOUSTON'S WILLIS, SEATTLE'S KEMP FINED.

text.p: Kevin Willis of the Houston Rockets and Shawn Kemp of the Seattle SuperSonics were fined by the NBA on Friday for their actions during Thursday night's Western Conference semifinal playoff game.
Willis was hit with a $10,000 fine and Kemp received a $5,000 fine by NBA Senior Vice President and discipline chief Rod Thorn, the league announced.
Willis was fined for elbowing Kemp in the head with three seconds left in the third quarter of Seattle's 99-96 Game Six victory that forced a seventh and deciding game in the series on Saturday.
Kemp's sanction was for retaliating by pushing Willis in the back of the head.
Seattle coach George Karl was furious after the contest, charging that Willis was trying to instigate a confrontation throughout the game.
